title: The segmented control's active option is invisible on a dark card
foundBy: repository owner, reading a consuming page in dark mode: "in dark mode, it's very hard to see what's selected"

evidence.verified: `npm run ci` passes on 6648d20 with every gate run. The control is not in the visual baseline, which excuses it as rendering inside other sections, so the check is by eye. On the consuming dispatch page in dark mode the active option is a teal tint with a teal ring, and the others are plain.

resolution: The active option is tinted with the accent background and ringed with the accent, the treatment a selected chip has, in place of a raised card. It reads on a dark card and on a light one.
details: The active option is drawn as a raised card: the card colour with a small shadow. On a dark card that colour is the card's own, and the shadow is black on near-black, so the only difference from the other options is the text weight. In light mode the white option on the grey track reads well, which is why it was not noticed.
